taxonomy: Overlapping architecture dimensions represented by six concrete embodiments; not mutually exclusive claims

candidates.accessibility_bridge: Semantic DOM through OS bridge; custom canvas needs equivalent semantics
candidates.platform_reach_and_dpi: Windows/Linux/macOS embodiments exist; exact D028/DPI/IME/GPU profile unqualified
candidates.packaging_update: Bundle application and browser/runtime; signed update/dependency closure; staged semantic compatibility
candidates.offline_behavior: Disposable authorized read cache, no offline grants; local assets can be bundled
candidates.testability: DOM + native bridge + AT + golden protocol tests
candidates.dependency_weight: Engine/runtime/transitive packages, renderer processes and graphics/fonts included
candidates.tradeoff_hypothesis: Bundled engine may reduce skew but owns patch duty
candidates.decisive_falsifier: Untrusted frame reaches bridge; required AT missing; N20 idle or tail breach
candidates.non_proof: No universal isolation, accessibility or resource advantage
candidates.evidence_class: mechanism primary-source documented; Recursion tradeoffs proposed; runtime fit unknown

candidates.rendering_model: OS webview plus narrow native messaging host
candidates.accessibility_bridge: Actual WebView2/WebKitGTK/WKWebView bridge must be evaluated
candidates.platform_reach_and_dpi: Per-OS engine/DPI/IME behavior; exact versions/profile U
candidates.packaging_update: App bundle plus platform webview/dependency owner; offline prerequisites; staged update
candidates.offline_behavior: Same read-cache contract; missing runtime cannot trigger unapproved install
candidates.dependency_weight: Application bytes plus shared/preinstalled webview, bridge/plugins and updates
candidates.tradeoff_hypothesis: Smaller payload is not necessarily smaller total footprint
candidates.decisive_falsifier: Required Linux webview AT/input unavailable or incompatible engine behavior; missing offline dependency
candidates.non_proof: No cross-engine parity or free shared dependencies
candidates.evidence_class: mechanism primary-source documented; Recursion tradeoffs proposed; runtime fit unknown

candidates.illustrative_embodiment: Qt Widgets-style or separate OS frontends
candidates.rendering_model: Retained controls and possible custom drawing
candidates.accessibility_bridge: Toolkit accessibility interfaces plus custom control adapters
candidates.platform_reach_and_dpi: Toolkit/platform support matrix distinct from accepted D028; scale/IME tests required
candidates.packaging_update: Native application plus toolkit/plugins/platform libraries; freeze supported ABI
candidates.offline_behavior: Independent typed client cache; no state writer
candidates.testability: Native automation, real AT and source-cut goldens
candidates.dependency_weight: Toolkit/plugins/fonts/optional render libraries; distinct OS module maintenance
candidates.tradeoff_hypothesis: OS integration may simplify controls; custom diff still needs semantics
candidates.decisive_falsifier: Custom diff missing text/actions, unsupported dependency floor or DPI/focus corruption
candidates.evidence_class: mechanism primary-source documented; Recursion tradeoffs proposed; runtime fit unknown

candidates.rendering_model: Declarative widget/scene/render tree with platform embedder
candidates.accessibility_bridge: Separate semantic tree synchronized with visual state
candidates.platform_reach_and_dpi: Embedder/engine/GPU/IME profile and native dialog tests
candidates.packaging_update: Engine/runtime/assets packaged per profile; shader and update closure
candidates.offline_behavior: Same scoped cache and detached runtime boundary
candidates.testability: Visual/semantic synchronization, AT, device fault and protocol tests
candidates.tradeoff_hypothesis: Visual consistency may increase cross-platform similarity, not qualification
candidates.decisive_falsifier: Semantic approval target diverges from visual target or device recovery relaunches work
candidates.evidence_class: mechanism primary-source documented; Recursion tradeoffs proposed; runtime fit unknown

candidates.rendering_model: Code-driven UI and draw data consumed by host renderer
candidates.accessibility_bridge: Unadapted cited embodiment lacks accessibility/full internationalization; adapted stable semantic bridge U
candidates.platform_reach_and_dpi: Host window/input/graphics backends; desktop parity not implied
candidates.packaging_update: Custom host/backends and deployment tooling; bridge remediations counted
candidates.offline_behavior: Pure projection can map naturally, cache remains nonauthoritative
candidates.testability: Independent keyboard/text/AT tree plus visual/golden tests; screenshot alone insufficient
candidates.tradeoff_hypothesis: Eventless frame scheduling may be efficient only after explicit idle design
candidates.decisive_falsifier: Missing accessibility in unadapted embodiment; unstable focus identities; unbounded idle loop
candidates.non_proof: Not all immediate-mode systems fail, no cheap remediation claim
candidates.evidence_class: mechanism primary-source documented; Recursion tradeoffs proposed; runtime fit unknown

candidates.accessibility_bridge: Browser accessibility tree to OS AT; real version/profile needed
candidates.platform_reach_and_dpi: Browser/OS/DPI/permissions versioned; no arbitrary local access
candidates.packaging_update: Browser provision/update plus origin/service-worker/application assets; version negotiation
candidates.offline_behavior: Cache may be evicted, tabs suspended; explicit last-sync; no auto outbox
candidates.dependency_weight: Browser shared resources and attributable incremental cost both reported
candidates.tradeoff_hypothesis: No dedicated app download does not imply no install/resource cost
candidates.decisive_falsifier: Origin confusion or arbitrary native dependency; offline cache grants authority; reconnect loses facts
candidates.non_proof: No durable cache, secure gateway or same-user secrecy proof
candidates.evidence_class: mechanism primary-source documented; Recursion tradeoffs proposed; runtime fit unknown
